findings: Provider request validation rejects malformed provider refs, key ids, material refs, AAD fingerprints, and provider-key drift before emitting receipts.
Targeted unit tests cover OpenBao encrypt/decrypt command shapes, OCI encrypt/decrypt command shapes, provider receipts, and provider-key drift rejection.
Provider-specific OpenBao/OCI details live only in adapter crates; domain owns the inward-facing port trait and validated request/receipt contract.
New KmsProviderCryptoPort is additive; existing cloud.kms API functions and tests remain unchanged.
No external SDK dependency added; small adapter crates follow existing workspace lint/test patterns.
Provider receipts carry provider_request_id and provider_evidence_ref for audit-chain correlation without raw secret material.
Adapter command bodies carry refs/fingerprints, not raw plaintext/ciphertext bytes or provider tokens.
Request translation is deterministic string assembly with no network call or allocation-heavy abstraction beyond command body construction.
Common provider contract avoids duplicating provider-neutral validation inside each adapter.
ChangeSet is isolated to KMS domain additions, two new crates, catalog rows, plan status, and evidence.
IP and phase index record adapter-port green status and explicitly preserve live-provider smoke as pending.
Avoids a false production claim: live-provider smoke is not claimed because CI lacks credentialed OpenBao/OCI execution.
Oya VCS claim accepted before writes; no raw git/gh promotion used.
FD-001 evidence, multispectrum evidence, and audit-chain row identify the same ChangeSet id.
Kept provider-specific behavior in two small adapter crates and a single provider-neutral port instead of duplicating KMS validation across API handlers.
No external SDK or runtime network dependency was introduced in this request-contract slice.
OpenBao transit and OCI KMS are represented as deterministic provider adapter command contracts behind the same domain port.
Receipts carry provider request and evidence refs needed for later audit-chain correlation while live provider smoke remains explicitly pending.
